ry":"Cell C8 loads the region (60x60 grid) for 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 and 2021-06-01..08-31. For each sea cell it computes per-day-of-year hazen 90th percentiles from ±5-day pools around 1992-2002 dates and smooths them with a wrapped 31-day mean. It compares target SST against the smoothed thresholds for days of year 153-244, which draw on raw thresholds 138-259, i.e. calendar dates May 12 to Sep 20 of each baseline year. It then builds runs and joins gaps and writes the mask to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
